goal: Speed up initial index synchronization for block filter and transaction indexes
Allow node runners to process block batches across multiple worker threads during initial sync
reviewability: Author is splitting out the thread pool into #33689 before updating this PR
agreement: Verified significant block filter index speedups on SSD (Sjors, pinheadmz, mzumsande)
Unaddressed objection: txindex is slower on SSD and parallel sync adds too much complexity (l0rinc)
Unaddressed objection: LevelDB write contention slows txindex sync on SSD by ~7% (andrewtoth)
Concept and approach approval for the parallel processing design (ryanofsky, sedited, w0xlt)
Unanswered question on how parallel indexing interacts with AssumeUTXO (maflcko)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because parallel block digestion dramatically cuts initial sync time for block filter indexes
Node runners building block filter indexes see multi-hour builds drop to under an hour on SSDs
Transaction index write contention on SSDs partially offsets gains but filter speedups are substantial

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it introduces a generic thread pool utility that other node subsystems can reuse
Serves as a helpful concurrent building block rather than solving an urgent deficiency
